description: System definition for case vocabulary. Cases organize related data around a question, topic, or investigation.

content.purpose: Govern data organization. A case is a container that collects related signals, alerts, files, and notes. Observable watchlists on cases enable automatic correlation — when new data matches a watched identifier, it auto-links to the case.
content.note: Observable types are defined in signalvocab (signal.vocab.observable_types). Cases REFERENCE those types when adding observables to watchlists.
